sql:
-- Let me verify the Feb 1st total by direct calculation:
SELECT SUM(GREATEST(balance, 0)) as total
FROM (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                 ELSE 0
            END
        ) as balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date::DATE <= DATE '2020-02-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)

-- For each month, calculate total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month)

WITH monthly_balances AS (

        m.month_start,

            CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
